caption: The drawing features a single figure of a young person standing and facing forward. The figure has a round face, pink cheeks, small red lips, and light yellow hair mostly hidden under a large brimmed tan hat with a purple ribbon and a black feather. The person is dressed in a light, translucent white dress decorated with patterns of purple diamonds and plus signs, extending to the ankles, with short puffed sleeves and a fitted waist. Both arms are hanging by the figure’s sides. The feet are bare and lightly rendered in beige, with toes visible. The background is a plain off-white with no additional elements, and the image includes the initials “RPB” in light blue near the bottom right corner.
title: Doll
